findings.claim: Task 1 does not verify bean registration. A learner can delete the bean step and have the controller call new CatalogConfig().workshopCatalog(); task1 still passes, so beans-and-bean-scopes#o1 (claimed in module.json) is untested.
findings.recommendation: Autowire ApplicationContext in task1 and assertEquals(1, ctx.getBeansOfType(WorkshopCatalog.class).size()); optionally assertSame the bean's findAll() size with GET /workshops after task3-independent seed.

findings.claim: Location must equal the relative /workshops/3. The idiomatic ServletUriComponentsBuilder.fromCurrentRequest().path("/{id}") yields http://localhost/workshops/3 under MockMvc and fails with a message that looks like a wrong answer.
findings.recommendation: Either assert with endsWith("/workshops/3") (header().string("Location", endsWith(...))) or add one README sentence: use a relative URI, e.g. URI.create("/workshops/" + id).
